The function writes only pnl (branch 4, lines 41-53), rr_ratio (lines 12-23 and 56-67) and updated_at (lines 24/30/36/69). A non-NULL pnl is returned unchanged and unrounded (lines 10-26). gross_pnl, commission and swap are never read or written.

issues.issue: The dedicated backtest journal is not exclusive and its lifecycle is not locked, so simulated P&L can enter real stats despite the 'own journal' rule. (1) delete_journal's reset branch keeps the same journal id when it is the user's last active journal (fn_delete_journal.sql:33-53). A free user with Ana Hesap + Backtest who deletes Ana Hesap, then Backtest, gets a general 'Ana Defter' journal that is still linked to the backtest account, and the next reconcile re-inserts the mirrors into it. (2) switch_default_journal can make the backtest journal the default (fn_switch_default_journal.sql:27-33). set_default_journal then routes NULL-journal inserts into it, and reset_user_data keeps and renames it (fn_reset_user_data.sql:39-50). (3) Manual, CSV and quick-add saves write to the active journal (add-trade.astro:1633, quick-add.js:2121 and 2495). (4) link_ctrader_account (fn_link_ctrader_account.sql:13-36) and prop accounts (fn_check_prop_account_limit.sql:16-24) accept any active journal. In all of these cases the journal totals stop equalling the backtest account's P&L.
issues.fix: Mark the journal, e.g. journals.platform = 'backtest' or a kind column, set when the account is created. Make the add-trade, quick-add and CSV flows, link_ctrader_account, prop-account creation and switch_default_journal refuse it. In delete_journal, both branches, delete or detach backtest accounts linked to the journal before the reset or delete. Do the same in reset_user_data. Hand-run migrations with rollback SQL, applied only with owner approval.

issues.issue: The proposed DB CHECK accepts numeric NaN. Postgres treats 'NaN' = 'NaN' as true and sorts NaN above all values, so commission >= 0, money = round(money,2) and the pnl identity all pass. numeric(p,s) also accepts NaN. The pseudo-code computeTradeMoney uses BigInt(contractSize), which throws for fractional contract sizes such as 0.1.

report:
The trigger analysis is correct; corrections are needed in the surrounding plan. I checked every claim against the live snapshots and the repo, ran node checks in the scratch folder, and read the official PostgreSQL docs. Nothing touched the live DB or any Edge Function, and no repo files changed.

**Trigger (confirmed)**
- trg_calc_pnl writes only pnl, rr_ratio and updated_at. It writes pnl only when pnl is NULL, the row is not a quick entry and both prices are set; the result is gross price P&L with no commission, swap or FX. A sent pnl is returned unchanged and unrounded. gross_pnl, commission and swap are never read or written.
- The ON CONFLICT, EXCLUDED, alphabetical-order and default-journal claims match the docs and fn_set_default_journal.sql.
- So backtest rows that always carry net pnl, gross_pnl, commission and swap pass through unchanged. The only side effects are updated_at and an rr_ratio that equals what the mapping computes.

**Rounding (verified)**
- The proposed BigInt Postgres-style rounding matches an independent decimal emulator on 200,000 fuzzed values, including negative ties.
- trgRR matches a faithful emulation of Postgres division and ROUND(.,2) on 100,005 cases. It diverges only around 1e17 risk units, so the analysis's bound is valid.
- One factual error: Math.round(x*100)/100 gives 2.68 and 1.05 for 2.675 and 1.045, matching Postgres. Only toFixed gives 2.67 and 1.04. Math.round fails on 1.005 and on negative exact ties (-0.125 → -0.12). The proposed test would fail as written.

**Writers and readers (confirmed)**
- Every writer stores pnl as net, and no reader subtracts commission again.
- Stored commission, gross_pnl and swap are used only by the trades edit modal.

**Gaps that affect "trades stays consistent with the backtest account"**
1. **The backtest journal is not exclusive (high).**
   - Manual, CSV and quick-add saves go to the active journal.
   - cTrader links and prop accounts accept any journal.
   - switch_default_journal can make it the default.
   - delete_journal's reset branch keeps the journal id when it is the user's last journal (fn_delete_journal.sql:33-53). The still-linked backtest account would then re-sync simulated trades into the user's general journal.
2. **Some readers are user-wide.** The overtrade and notification checks (overtrade.js:387-392 and 568-573, navbar.js:640-645, notifications.js:185-190) and the platform counters ignore journal_id. Mirrors in the last 7 days would count.
3. **Self-healing undoes resets.** The onboarding and settings resets delete trades but not the new backtest tables, so the reconcile re-inserts the mirrors.
4. **Staging cannot be built from the repo.** No migration creates public.trades, so testing needs a production schema dump with owner approval.
5. **Smaller items.**
   - Dispatch `trade-saved` after each sync so the 2-minute cache is cleared.
   - The guard CHECK must exclude NaN.
   - In the pseudo-code, `BigInt(contractSize)` throws on fractional sizes.
   - evaluate_prop_firm_rules also counts rows with status = 'closed', the column default.
   - list_journals P&L has no UI consumer; the navbar shows only trade_count.
   - The pre-existing cTrader partial-close failure never advances the cursor, so syncing for that account stays broken.
